name: Strategy 7
description: Living indicator on rooms: a room is a band the market sat in (cluster of closes), retired after N sessions without a visit; Strategy 1 SETUPs (1-minute) gated by the room card TAKE / WATCH / BLOCK, re-entry only after a held leave of the room. Fills, stop and exits as Strategy 1; REENTER adds a band-reclaim exit.

backtests.label: All data
backtests.notes: every session with data, after the warm-up

backtests.label: Design period
backtests.notes: the rules were built on this window

backtests.label: Unseen test
backtests.notes: unseen for Foundation rules; used for FZ threshold selection and gate-state design, so not out of sample for FZ (volume-blind: not the front month)

birth_a_source.note: rooms are born from sits only; protected_level / every_swing stay available as diagnostics

merge_overlap.note: rooms: a sit overlapping a live room by at least half the width is a visit of that room; otherwise a new room, clipped at live rooms' edges

zone_max_age_sessions.note: band model chart view only; rooms retire through room_max_age_sessions

room_model.note: a room is a band the market sat in; see FZ.md v2

drift_birth.note: no drift births: a room is born only on the transition into a sit

room_overlap.source: user decision 2026-09-27 call 2 (vs rooms not visited this session)
room_overlap.statistic: clip, the first reading, cut 131 of 226 rooms and left slivers (D 09-02 12:45 0.65 pt wide, F 09-02 14:38 10.25 pt), the 10-pt stagger the brief rejects (1m, all data)
room_overlap.note: a sit overlapping live rooms by less than merge_overlap is a new full-width room and retires them; alternative 'clip' (edges stop at the neighbours')

room_max_age_sessions.note: "yesterday's shelf, not a two-month hash" (user brief)

visit_min_bars.note: a stay of fewer inside closes that ends by the leave rule is a touch, not a visit

hunt_form.statistic: one close outside then a close back inside; a wick pierce with the close inside is routine (29% of 1m inside bars)

hunt_max_bars.note: 1 or 2 closes outside then back inside is a HUNT; the 3rd close outside is the LEAVE (leave_closes)

hunt_min_depth_atr.statistic: not used by the close form

hunt_burst.statistic: no tape statistic; skipped when volume NA

reject_tol.statistic: wick within eps of an edge, not beyond: 3.7/22/39/75% of inside bars at 0/1/2/5 pts (1m, live protected-level band, all data)

leave_closes.note: bound 3 so HUNT and LEAVE do not overlap

leave_far_side.note: S35 unchanged: user decision pending; alternatives 'any', 'no_band'

open_sit_closes.note: open guard: the pierced band has fewer than this many closes inside today ('no sit')

same_session_overlap.note: a sit overlapping a live room already visited this session is a visit of it, never a birth; the older room keeps its edges

session_visit_rule.note: 'visited this session' = a real sit today (at least cluster_bars consecutive same-session closes inside the room), not any close; alternative 'any_close'

adjacent_birth.note: a sit whose band edge is within band_half_width of a live room sat in this session (overlapping or not) is not a birth and not a visit (sits_near_room); alternative 'allow'

defend_half.note: a defend TAKE also needs the SETUP close in the half of the room away from the defended edge (above the mid for a long, below for a short); otherwise WATCH, take_why defend_wrong_half; alternative 'off'

room_edges.note: a room's lo / hi are the min / max close of the sit that bore it (the cluster_bars window), frozen at birth; mid = (lo + hi) / 2; alternative 'half_width' (mid +- band_half_width)

absorb_rule.note: a sit is a visit of a live room only when its mid lies inside that room; otherwise it is a birth candidate for same_session_overlap / adjacent_birth / room_overlap; alternative 'overlap' (merge_overlap x the sit's width)

defend_direction.note: after a defend TAKE one way in a visit, a defend the other way in the same visit is WATCH, take_why defend_opposite_in_visit; alternative 'any'

same_day_replace.note: a sit not absorbed by mid_inside whose close range overlaps or touches a live room born earlier the same session retires that room (retired_by same_day_replace) and is born in its place; rooms from earlier days keep keep_older / adjacent_birth protection; alternative 'off'
